Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX 4.2 (Always unencrypted, must be first field in message)

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be second field in message)

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: (Always unencrypted, must be third field in message)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Message sequence number (inbound to Aquis) for today's trading session

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Set to Y on retransmitted messages (e.g. following a Resend Request)

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sending firm, as agreed with Aquis

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Time of message transmission in UTC

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID representing Aquis MTF, as agreed

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Set to Y to indicate that message may contain information that has been sent under another sequence number. Aquis will process Order Cancel Request messages that are flagged as possible re-sends under a new sequence number. Aquis will not process New Order Single or Order Cancel/Replace Request messages that are flagged as re- sent under a new sequence number

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: ID representing trading Member, as agreed with Aquis, for service bureau connections

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For retransmitted messages (PossDupFlag = Y), the time in UTC that the message was initially sent. If not available, then set to same value as SendingTime

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The value originally sent to Aquis as the OnBehalfOfCompID if received from a service bureau

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Standard FIX trailer checksum

Message.Name: New Order Single
Message.Description: Aquis supports the FIX New Order Single message for order entry.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional account field to specify House or Client Account for use with clearing CCP. If not supplied, Aquis will assume House

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique for each order on this session for the trading day. Maximum length 20 characters. Note that for performance reasons Aquis only validates that ClOrdID is unique, rejecting any duplicates, against currently open orders

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) Values accepted: GBX - Sterling (in pence), GBP - Sterling (in pounds), EUR - Euro, CHF - Suisse Franc, DKK - Danish Krone, NOK - Norwegian Krone, SEK - Swedish Krona, USD - United States Dollar

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Required if OrdType=P. Instructions for order handling. Values supported by Aquis: M = Midpoint peg (pegged to midpoint of PBBO), R = Near Touch Peg, W = Peg to VWAP. Only ExecInst (18) = R (Near Touch Peg) is supported for AoD orders. Please see section 5.6.4 for details on AOD Midpoint Pegged orders. Only ExecInst (18) = M (Midpoint peg) and W (Peg to VWAP) are valid when OrdType (40) = P (Pegged).

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: 1 = Automated execution order (private, no broker intervention). Note this is the only acceptable value (default if not supplied)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Aquis: 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC

Field.Name: IOIID
Field.Description: ClOrdID (Tag 11) of the invited IOI, must be sent for firm up orders.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of shares

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: 2 = Limit, 5 = Market on Close, for the Aquis Market at Close (MaC), P = Pegged, for the Aquis Matching Pool (AMP), Dark-to-lit order sweep and Aquis VWAP Match (AVM). Only OrdType (40) = 2 (Limit) is valid for AoD. See section 5.6.4 for AoD pegging options.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Limit price is required for limit orders; Not supported on MaC orders. Not required for AMP only orders. Required for Sweep Orders.

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Values supported by Aquis: A = AOTC, P = DEAL (default if tag not supplied), R = MTCH

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: If using alternative symbology, RIC (primary or Aquis) or ISIN depending on the value of IDSource (22)

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: 1 = Buy, 2 = Sell

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security (not required if alternative symbology is used)

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 = Day (default if tag not supplied), 3 = Immediate or Cancel (IOC), 4 = Fill or Kill (FOK), 6 = Good Till Date - will expire at time in ExpireTime (126) field. Date must be today's date. 8 = Good For Auction (GFA). Only Day orders are valid for the Market at Close (MaC). Only Day, GFA and IOC orders are valid for the AoD. GFA orders are only valid for the AoD. IOC will be treated as Accept-Or-Cancel (AOC) when 27010 (AquisOrderAttribute) = 3 or 4. Only Day and IOC orders are valid for Sweep Orders. Only Day, IOC and FOK orders are available for dark orders. Only DAY and IOC orders are valid for when Conditional Orders are firmed up, 8002 (ConditionalType) = 2. Only DAY is valid for IOIs. Only DAY orders are valid for Aquis Smart Mid. Only Day orders are valid for AVM

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order entry request was initiated by the trading Member.

Field.Name: ExDestination
Field.Description: OPMX indicates the order can be exposed to OptimX in addition to being exposed to the standard AMP book. Only supported when 8002 (ConditionalType) = 1 * OptimX only supported on AQXD*

Field.Name: ClientId
Field.Description: * OptimX ONLY TAG*. Max length 20 characters.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed. Only valid when AquisOrderAttribute (27010) = 3,4 or OrdType (40) = P. Mandatory for AMP only orders and AVM-only orders; if MinQty is not required, specify a value of 0.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity for an iceberg order. The remainder of the order quantity is held in reserve and is not visible. The display quantity of all orders at a given price level will be traded first and then the hidden quantity. When the display quantity has been fully traded it is refreshed from the reserve.

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: 1 = Initial (Default), 3 = Random. Defines if the value of the peak quantity after a refresh will be determined absolutely (using the initial value of the MaxFloor (111) or randomly (using a random value between DisplayLowQty (1085) and DisplayHighQty (1086).

Field.Name: DisplayLowQty
Field.Description: Defines the lower quantity limit to a randomised refresh of displayed quantity. DisplayLowQty (1085) must be less than or equal to DisplayHighQty (1086). Required if DisplayMethod (1084) = 3

Field.Name: DisplayHighQty
Field.Description: Defines the upper quantity limit to a randomized refresh of displayed quantity. Required if DisplayMethod (1084) = 3

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Date/time in UTC of order expiry for a Good Till Date order, with TimeInForce (59) = 6. Date must be today's date.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). Aquis will accept valid MICs.

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: Optional signed value up to five decimal places which will be added to the peg calculation. Value should be < 0 for an aggressive offset on a sell order. Only supported when AquisOrderAttribute (27010) = 4 and ExecInst (18) = R. PegDifference is rounded (down for buy, up for sell) to fit the tick size.

Field.Name: DEAFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order originates from a Direct Electronic Access Client 0 = No (default), 5 = Yes

Field.Name: ConditionalType
Field.Description: Absence of this tag indicates a firm order. 1 = IOI, 2 = Firm-Up

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: Tag can contain multiple values (separated by spaces). The presence of a value indicates the following: 2 = Liquidity provision activity, 4 = Algorithmic order

Field.Name: Internalisation
Field.Description: Self-trade prevention to prevent members trading against their own orders. 0 = Not-enabled (default), 4 = Self-trade prevention enabled. Only valid when OrdType (40) = P. If set to 0, configured self-trade prevention settings will be ignored. See Self-Trade Prevention (2.5).

Field.Name: ClientBlacklist
Field.Description: List of OptimX Client IDs to block from the IOI. Members may block up to two OptimX Client IDs. NB. Aquis will not validate the values in this tag. Only valid when ExDestination (100) = OPMX * OptimX currently only supported on AQXD*

Field.Name: ContraOrderID
Field.Description: The Order ID of the contra as provided by OptimX * OptimX currently only supported on AQXD*

Field.Name: OptimXClientDomain
Field.Description: Absence of this tag will default to A (Show to all OptimX Clients) A = Show to all OptimX Clients, M = Show to current broker clients only. Only valid when ExDestination (100) = OPMX * OptimX currently only supported on AQXD*

Field.Name: RequestCrossingWaiverType
Field.Description: Specifies whether an order may be executed under: 1 = either Reference Price Waiver (RPW) or Large in Scale Waiver (LIS) (Default), 2 = only under LIS waiver

Field.Name: AquisOrderAttribute
Field.Description: Values supported when OrdType (40) = 2: 0 = Continuous Limit Order Book Regular Order (default), 1 = Continuous Limit Order Book Post-Only Order, 2 = Continuous Limit Order Book POCR Order, 3 = Auction on Demand Limit Order, 4 = Auction on Demand Limit (Pegged/Limit Order), 5 = Continuous Limit Order Book Restricted Post Only Order*, 6 = Continuous Limit Order Book Restricted POCR Order*. Order Sweep Values supported when OrdType (40) = P: 0 = Route to lit (Sweep order DLO or DLOD), 1 = Route to lit and Post Only (Sweep order DLPO), 2 = Route to Lit and POCR, 5 = Route to Lit and Restricted Post Only Order*, 6 = Route to Lit and Restricted POCR Order*, 8 = Aquis Smart Mid (ASM) *with optional IOC or FOK for aggressive behaviour.

Message.Name: Order Cancel Request
Message.Description: Aquis supports the FIX Order Cancel Request message to fully cancel an open order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the cancel request. Maximum length 20 characters

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier for the original or last modified version of the order

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order cancel request was initiated by the trading Member

Field.Name: DEAFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order originates from a Direct Electronic Access Client 0 = No (default), 5 = Yes

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: Tag can contain multiple values (separated by spaces). The presence of a value indicates the following: 2 = Liquidity provision activity, 4 = Algorithmic order

Message.Name: Order Cancel Replace Request
Message.Description: Aquis supports the FIX Order Cancel/Replace Request message for order modification.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the replacement order on this session for the trading day. Maximum length 20 characters.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Required if OrdType=P. Instructions for order handling. Values supported by Aquis: M = Midpoint peg (pegged to midpoint of PBBO)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: New total order quantity (number of shares)

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Identifier for the original or last modified version of the order

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: New limit price, required for limit orders

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Values supported by Aquis: A = AOTC, P = DEAL (default if tag not supplied), R = MTCH

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: As provided on the original order. Not required if tag was not included on the original order

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: TIF cannot be modified

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time this order modification request was initiated by the trading Member

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: New minimum quantity (shares) of an order to be executed. Mandatory when OrdType (40) = P.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: New display quantity for an iceberg order, otherwise original value will be reused

Field.Name: DEAFlag
Field.Description: Whether the order originates from a Direct Electronic Access Client 0 = No (default), 5 = Yes

Field.Name: ConditionalType
Field.Description: Absence of this tag indicates a firm order. 1 = IOI, 2 = Firm-Up

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: Tag can contain multiple values (separated by spaces). The presence of a value indicates the following: 2 = Liquidity provision activity, 4 = Algorithmic order

Field.Name: AquisOrderAttribute
Field.Description: 0 = No constraint, regular order (default if tag not supplied), 1 = Post-Only Order, 2 = POCR, 4 = Post Only Restricted Order, 5 = POCR Restricted Order

Message.Name: Trade Capture Report
Message.Description: Aquis uses the Trade Capture Report message from later versions of the FIX specification (specifically 4.4) as an extension to our existing FIX 4.2 ports for the purposes of allowing members to submit negotiated trades to the exchange.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Optional account field to specify House or Client Account for use with clearing CCP. If not supplied, Aquis will assume 'House'.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN) Values accepted: GBX - Sterling (in pence), GBP - Sterling (in pounds), EUR - Euro, CHF - Suisse Franc, DKK - Danish Krone, NOK - Norwegian Krone, SEK - Swedish Krona, USD - United States Dollar

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by Aquis: 4 = ISIN, 5 = RIC. Please refer to Section 5.1.2

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of the trade

Field.Name: LastQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the trade

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: If using alternative symbology, RIC (primary or Aquis) or ISIN depending on the value of IDSource (22)

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security (not required if alternative symbology is used)

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time the transaction represented by this TCR occurred (expressed in UTC)

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Date of trade referenced in this message in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required if ISIN is used to identify the security, IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). Aquis will accept valid MICs

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Unique identifier for the Trade Capture Report

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: Trade type indicating: 1 = Block Trade (default if not supplied, LIS_CROSS), 6 = Weighted Average Price Trade (defined in tag 829)

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: Further definition to tag 828 as required: 0 = Block Trade for clearing, 1 = Block Trade not for clearing, 2 = Volume Weighted Average Price Trade for clearing, 3 = Volume Weighted Average Price Trade not for clearing, 4 = Time Weighted Average Price Trade for clearing, 5 = Time Weighted Average Price Trade not for clearing * = Self-trade suppression for clearing at the session level takes precedence if the value in tag 829 is 0, 2 or 4 (See Section 2.3).

Field.Name: OrderAttribute
Field.Description: The presence of the following value indicates that the transaction was executed as a result of algorithmic trading as defined in Article 4(1)(39) of Directive 2014/65/EU (default if tag not supplied = No): 4 = Algorithmic trade

Message.Name: Execution Report
Message.Description: Aquis uses the FIX Execution Report message to accept or to reject a New Order Single, and to accept an Order Cancel Request or an Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Account is returned for Order Acknowledgements, Trade Acknowledgements and Rejects if provided on the original New Order Single message.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of quantity so far traded on this order (zero if no trade)

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: The current ClOrdID identifier of the order, or the ClOrdID of the request that is being accepted

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity so far traded on this order (zero if no trade)

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Currency in which the security is traded

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique ID for the trading day for this Execution Report Corresponds to the TVTIC (RTS 24 Art.12 & RTS 22 Field 3 Table 2). Please note, for the purposes of transaction reporting the letter prefix (e.g. 'B' or 'S') should be removed from the unique ID and only the numeric code reported

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: As provided on the original order.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Sent for a trade bust (ExecTransType = 1) to identify the earlier Execution ID for the original trade

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0 = New (for order related messages and trade reports), 1 = Cancel (for a trade bust)

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: LastMkt
Field.Description: Provides the Aquis MIC for the execution: AQXE - Aquis PLC lit trades including MaC, AQXA - Aquis PLC AoD trades, AQXD - Aquis PLC non-display (AMP) trades, AVXE - Aquis PLC VWAP Match (AVM) trades, AQEU - Aquis Europe lit trades including MaC, AQEA - Aquis Europe AoD trades, AQED - Aquis Europe non-display (AMP) trades, AVEU - Aquis Europe VWAP Match (AVM) trades

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this trade (zero if not a trade)

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of this trade (zero if not a trade)

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Aquis order reference number

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Quantity of the order

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Status of the order, values sent by Aquis: 0 = New, 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for Day, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected, C = Expired

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: As provided on the original order. For Order Sweeps refer to 'Order Sweeps' section of specification.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the order that is being cancelled or replaced (for solicited cancel or replace responses only)

Field.Name: Price

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: As provided on the original order or as provided on a modified MaC order

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Uniform symbology code for the security

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: To provide error text in case of a reject message or cancellation reason if a resting order is force cancelled

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of this event in UTC

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Display quantity applicable to an iceberg order

Field.Name: DisplayMethod
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: DisplayLowQty
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: DisplayHighQty
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: The value originally sent to Aquis as the OnBehalfOfCompID if received from a service bureau

Field.Name: PegDifference
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this report, values sent by Aquis: 0 = New, 1 = Partially Filled, 2 = Filled, 3 = Done for Day, 4 = Cancelled, 5 = Replaced, 8 = Rejected, C = Expired, D = Restated

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity still open for execution

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: The Aquis market data order ID for tracking purposes, sent on a restatement message after the refresh of displayed quantity for an iceberg order

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: As provided on the original order

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, the identifier of the CCP unless a CCP-suppressed 'self-trade' where the value is set to 'SELF'

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only provided on Restatement for iceberg or MaC orders: 4 = Broker option - indicates iceberg order has refreshed or MaC order has fully matched, 5 = Partial reduction of order quantity (exchange initiated partial cancel) - indicates MaC order has partially matched

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only provided on trade reports, if present value will = 1

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: FIX 4.4 tag for trade liquidity indicator. Only provided on trade reports, values sent by Aquis: 1 = Added liquidity, 2 = Removed liquidity, 4 = Auction (for AoD and MaC trades)

Field.Name: TVTIC
Field.Description: Returned on trades. The TVTIC required for transaction reporting purposes.

Field.Name: DEAFlag
Field.Description: Returned when OrdType (40) = P if provided on the original order. 0 = No (default), 5 = Yes

Field.Name: ConditionalType
Field.Description: 1 = IOI (Invite), 2 = Firm Up

Field.Name: TrdRegPublicationReasons
Field.Description: Only provided when OrdType (40) = P. For orders, indicates the pre-trade transparency waiver under which the order is considered in the matching engine. For trades, indicates the pre-trade transparency waiver under which the trade was conducted. Values sent by Aquis: 3 = Reference Price Waiver, 9 = Large in Scale Waiver

Field.Name: OrderAttributeTypes
Field.Description: Only provided when OrdType (40) = P if provided on the original order.

Field.Name: CrossingDuration
Field.Description: Provided on the restatement of AVM trades. Durations are expressed in minutes, values sent by Aquis: 5 = 5 Minutes

Message.Name: Order Cancel Reject
Message.Description: Aquis rejects an Order Cancel Request or an Order Cancel/Replace Request that it cannot act upon with a FIX Order Cancel Reject message.

Field.Name: OrderID

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID

Field.Name: Price

Field.Name: Text

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: The type of request that this is a response to: 1 = Order Cancel Request, 2 = Order Cancel/Replace Request

Field.Name: PartyID

Field.Name: PartyIDSource

Field.Description: 0 = None (default should short code = 0, 1, 2 or 3), 22 = Algorithm (PartyRole = 12 or 122), 23 = Firm or LEI (PartyRole = 3), 24 = Natural Person (PartyRole = 3, 12 or 122)
